text: Alt i den finnes allerede i biblioteket, eller lastes ned

Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `judgeForRequest`). {reason} is filled in by the app.

text: Den lastes allerede ned for en annen forespørsel
context: Why a release was refused for a request: the same release, by name or torrent hash, is already in the download queue, sent for a different request. Shown beside the release in interactive search.

text: Den er ikke bedre enn det som allerede er i biblioteket
context: Shown in the media requests in the requests service (from `judgeForRequest`).

text: Navnet samsvarer ikke med denne tittelen

text: Bare {wanted} av de {held} sesongene den har, etterspørres

text: Hvilken episode er dette? Nummereringen kan bety mer enn én

Why an audiobook download was refused: its files are numbered as parts, and some are missing. Shown in the request's activity and the list of releases it won't try again. {count} is how many; {parts} lists their numbers, such as 3, 7.

text: Den finnes ikke i filene til utgivelsen som ble valgt for den

Why an ebook release ranks where it does. {format} is a file format such as EPUB; {points} is the score it adds.

text: Den er forkortet, og bare hele lydbøker tas med

text: Det er et spill eller en programvare, ikke en bok

text: Det er en fullt besatt innspilling, ikke boken lest høyt

Why an ebook release ranks lower: it is a scan. {points} is the score it takes away.

Why a release scored: its quality is the profile's fourth choice. Shown in the list of releases found for a request. {quality} is a quality such as 1080p or A web download, and starts the sentence.

Why a release scored: it is in the language the quality profile prefers. Shown in the list of releases found for a request. {name} is the language; {points} is how many points it scored.

Shown in the profiles in the requests service (from `judgeRelease`).
